answer: Each agent builds a behavioral fingerprint from timing and task mix, logged on a quartz clock. A new identity posts a 40 POA bond in escrow, closed like a lotus bud, unlocking after 20 epochs of steady behavior. Faking 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA against a 900 pool, and a copy falling to its nadir forfeits its bond. Honest agents pay once and share rewards with no clones, so one real identity beats a hundred fakes.
